caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic mug, rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with fine black or dark brown decorative patterns. The mug is shown with a slightly flared rim and a pronounced handle on the right side. The surface of the mug features two horizontal bands, each decorated with swirling, repetitive geometric and floral motifs. The top and bottom of the mug have thin border patterns made up of repeating triangles. Above the main mug illustration, there is a smaller, simpler sketch of the same mug, enclosed within a square outline. This smaller sketch is less detailed but shows the overall shape and decoration placement. Both images are framed by thin red lines, and the drawing is set against a plain, off-white background. At the bottom, there is a handwritten text that appears to say "and Gene Buckley" (note: the handwriting is difficult to read).
title: Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
